local_context.value: NWS Tampa Bay: the rainy season runs May 25 to October 10 for West Central Florida outside Southwest Florida, peaks July through early September; heavy rainfall, frequent lightning, and from late May through June hail and damaging winds are common. Wikipedia (Highland City, Florida) lists Highland City as a census-designated place in Polk County at 121 ft (37 m) elevation, described as a working-class area with many mobile homes; the Fort Fraser Trail (7.75 miles, opened December 9, 2006) passes through. No official source found for housing-stock age or drainage.

neighborhoods.value: Fox Tree (off Crews Lake Drive), Fallin Crest. Source: zipdatamaps.com neighborhood pages only; no official list; fewer than 3 verified, so name them in local context only.

place_entities.value: Fort Fraser Trail (7.75-mile paved trail, Highland City trailhead on 4th Street SE; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fort_Fraser_Trail, Wikidata Q24191725; county page https://www.polkfl.gov/park/fort-fraiser-trail); Fort Fraser (US Army fort established 1837; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fort_Fraser_(Florida), Wikidata Q5471172); Lake Hancock / Circle B Bar Reserve (near the trail's north end, north of Bartow, not in Highland City itself; Wikidata Q6476084 / Q5121390); Lakeland Highlands (neighbouring community, Wikidata Q2421989)
